scope: Two high-resolution pixel-style concept sheets referencing current skeleton-derived heads. Not native 64x64 sprites, not exact mesh projections, no animation or learning.

prompts.B2:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: pixel-art concept comparison sheet, not an engine-ready sprite atlas.
Create a faithful pixel-art translation of input image 1, the CURRENT skeleton-derived v2/13 B dog head sheet. Retain its four rows of breeds and FIVE columns (left-facing side, left-facing three-quarter, front, back, top). Exactly 20 heads. Head and short neck only. Preserve each head's skull proportions, shortened muzzle length, round black eyes and individual nose size, ear attachment and short-neck connection from image 1. Make the muzzle a supported rounded volume, never a cone or beak, never a second blob below the black nose. Keep mouths neutrally closed, no tongues. Make the thin whippet lower jaw remain thin. Dachshund has longest hanging ears; golden has broad medium hanging ears; whippet small folded rose ears; Maltipoo short groomed rounded cheeks and padded hanging ears. Do not turn all heads into the same breed.
Input 2 is STYLE ONLY: reference-sheet.png SHA256 654330121aa768fefddfbd0909e6975bb1b8bac539d533325364ba111cd8e744, original 1774x887. Never transfer its grey-white markings, head shape, eyes, tongue or hairstyle. Inputs 3/4/5 are identity references ONLY: red-brown dachshund, brindle-and-white whippet, cream short-groom Maltipoo. Golden's golden coat and broad ears follow current model input 1. Preserve CURRENT model's shortened stylized muzzle proportions rather than restoring photo-realistic long muzzles. Use photographs for coat and broad breed cues. Whippet: simplify brindle into 2-3 connected large grey-taupe patches with pale muzzle/neck; no scattered stripes. Hidden markings are illustrative estimates, avoid invented ornamental patterns.
Pixel medium: visibly square, coarse, crisp grid, approximately 64x64 logical cells per head-and-neck motif, flat connected colour clusters, intentional stair-step contours. Each dog has ONE outline hue plus at most FOUR fill hues total including eyes/nose and shadows. Solid darkest brown/black eyes and nose, no glossy gradients. Upper-left light; one large shadow under jaw, ear and far neck. No antialias blur, no dithering, no noise, no fine hairs, no dense curls, no 3D smooth shading. Fur is suggested with a few large contour steps, silhouette must remain anchored to input 1.
Layout: landscape 2400x1600-style board, warm plain ivory background, generous equal cells and margins. Four rows ordered Golden Retriever, Whippet, Dachshund, Maltipoo. Five columns SIDE / 3-4 / FRONT / BACK / TOP. Small restrained readable labels. Title and tiny footer only; no decorative graphics or palettes. All heads same display logic and ample padding. Footer exact: "PIXEL CONCEPT / USER REVIEW PENDING". This is an artistic concept drawing, do not print "native 64x64", "validated", or imply exact mesh or sprite conversion.
STYLE VARIANT B2: use ONLY LEFT HALF of input 2 x=[0,887), y=[0,887), style ID nana-soft-B2-v1. Soft coat-related dark coloured outline, still crisp and continuous; eyes and nose darkest and more prominent than outline. Exact title: "B2 / SOFT PIXEL".
